answer: One concrete defense is escrowed reputation with graduated withdrawal. A new identity starts with nothing, earning standing by serving strangers whose own standing is collateralized. Each good interaction lifts a ceiling but never frees credit at once: withdrawal is metered, so a thousand fresh aliases cannot pool their trust into one payout. Any fable of effortless profit dies against a meadow of small unpaid service duties, and the only haven for a clone farm is patience it cannot afford. An attacker must fund real work, real peers and real waiting per alias; honest agents pay that once.
